Board configuration, membership, the team structures that own boards, and the grants of `manage_structure` (KAIROS-T-0337).

## boards

### `GET /api/boards`

List boards (open tenant-wide).

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `limit` | query | no | `integer` | Page size (default 50, max 200). |
| `offset` | query | no | `integer` | Rows to skip (default 0). |

| Response | Body | Meaning |

| `401` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Missing/invalid token |

### `POST /api/boards`

Create a board seeded with the system default columns/transitions for
its level (KAIROS-A-0002). An organization admin, or `manage_structure`
on the organization (KAIROS-T-0337). A grant on one board does not count:
the new board is not that board.

A delivery board needs a team (COLLIERY-T-0230). A request for a
delivery board with no `team_id` is a 422. The board of a task decides
its team, and a request to a board with no team goes to nobody. The
check is in `kairos_db::boards::create_board`, which every entry point
shares.

A strategy or initiative board has a team (KAIROS-T-0440,
KAIROS-A-0026). It is the `team_id` of the request. With no `team_id`,
Kairos makes an empty team `<level>-<slug>` with its charter. An admin
adds people to it. Board members and grants still work.

An ADR board can have a team (COLLIERY-T-3102). That board holds the
delivery ADRs of the team. Its `code_prefix` must be the
prefix of the delivery board of the team. If not, the request is a 422
`VALIDATION` with `details.field` = `code_prefix` and
`details.expected`. An ADR board with no `team_id` is a board of the
organization.

A team has one ADR board. A request for a second one is a 422
`TEAM_HAS_ADR_BOARD`, and the refusal names the board that the team has.

A team has one delivery board (COLLIERY-T-0240). A request for a
delivery board for a team that has a live delivery board is a 422
`TEAM_HAS_DELIVERY_BOARD`. The refusal names the board that the team
has. A deleted board does not count.

A `slug` must have the form of a board slug (COLLIERY-T-0258). It must
match `^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{1,62}$`, and it cannot have the form of a UUID.
If not, the request is a 422 `VALIDATION` with `details.field` = `slug`.

A live board has its slug alone (COLLIERY-T-0255). A request with the
slug of a live board is a 409 `CONFLICT`. The refusal names the slug
and the board that has it (`details.slug`, `details.board`). A deleted
board does not keep its slug.

Each board has a short-code prefix, `code_prefix` (COLLIERY-T-3099). It
is required, and it never changes. An item on the board gets the code
`{code_prefix}-{type letter}-{number}`. The number comes from the
sequence of the prefix and the type.

A prefix that does not match `^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]{1,9}$` is a 422
`VALIDATION` with `details.field` = `code_prefix`.

Boards can share a prefix when they hold different types. The level
gives the types. A prefix that a live board of the same level has is a
409 `CONFLICT`. The refusal names the prefix and the board that has it
(`details.code_prefix`, `details.board`).

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Idempotency-Key` | header | no | `string`, nullable | Optional. A key that you choose for this write: 8 to 128 characters of letters, digits, '.', '_', ':' and '-' (a UUID is a good key). Send it when you may retry the request. For 24 hours, a request with the same key and the same arguments writes nothing and gives the first status and body again, with the header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`. The same key with other arguments is refused with REQUEST_KEY_REUSED (KAIROS-A-0065). |

Request body (required): `application/json`, [`CreateBoardRequest`](../schemas/#createboardrequest)

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `201` | [`BoardDetail`](../schemas/#boarddetail) | Created, with the seeded configuration |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Not an org admin, and no manage_structure on the organization |
| `409` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | A live board has the slug, or a live board of the same level has the prefix; details.board names it; or REQUEST_KEY_REUSED: the Idempotency-Key was used for a different request |
| `422` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Bad level/team reference, a slug that does not have the form of a board slug, a code_prefix that is absent or does not match the rule, a delivery board with no team, a strategy or initiative board with a team, the prefix of a team ADR board that is not the prefix of the team, TEAM_HAS_DELIVERY_BOARD, or TEAM_HAS_ADR_BOARD |

### `DELETE /api/boards/{id}`

Soft-delete a board. Only allowed when NO workflow item references it
(422 `BOARD_NOT_EMPTY` otherwise — the T-0010 empty rule applied at
board scope). Requires `configure_boards` on the board.

A board that is the owner of a live document is not deleted
(COLLIERY-T-0269): 422 `BOARD_OWNS_DOCUMENTS`. A document always has
an owner. Name a different board for each document, or archive it.

The only delivery board of a team is not deleted (COLLIERY-T-0241): 422
`LAST_DELIVERY_BOARD`. A team always has a delivery board. To remove
the board, delete the team (`DELETE /api/teams/{id}`), which removes
the team and its board together. This check comes before the check for
live items, because no retry can pass it.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | yes | `string` | Board id (UUID) |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`OrgDeleteResponse`](../schemas/#orgdeleteresponse) | Soft-deleted |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Missing capability |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown board |
| `422` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | BOARD_NOT_EMPTY, LAST_DELIVERY_BOARD, or BOARD_OWNS_DOCUMENTS |

### `PATCH /api/boards/{id}`

Update board settings (name/slug). Requires `configure_boards` on the
board.

The team of a board does not change (COLLIERY-T-0230, COLLIERY-T-0243).
A `team_id` that is not the team of the board is a 422
`BOARD_TEAM_IS_FIXED`, and the update writes nothing. To give work to a
different team, move the task (`POST /api/tasks/{code}/move`).

The server accepts a `team_id` equal to the team of the board, and
changes nothing. A client can thus send back the `team_id` that it
read. That `team_id` is not a field to update: the body must have `name`
or `slug`.

A new `slug` must have the form of a board slug (COLLIERY-T-0258). If
not, the request is a 422 `VALIDATION`, and the update writes nothing.
A board with a slug from before the rule keeps that slug. An update of
the name of that board passes.

A `slug` that a different live board has is a 409 `CONFLICT`, and the
update writes nothing (COLLIERY-T-0255). The refusal names the slug and
the board that has it. A board can keep its slug in an update.

The body has the fields `name`, `slug`, `team_id`, `parent_gate`,
`owner_gate` and `blockers_gate` only. A different field of the board (`id`, `board_level`) is a 422
`VALIDATION` that names the field (COLLIERY-T-0249).

`parent_gate` sets a board policy of a delivery board (KAIROS-T-0641).
With the policy on, a task moves into a claims column only while its
parent initiative is active. On a board of a different level, the field
is a 422 `VALIDATION`.

`owner_gate` sets a board policy of an initiative board (KAIROS-T-0643).
With the policy on, an initiative moves into its Active column only with
an owner. On a board of a different level, the field is a 422
`VALIDATION`.

`blockers_gate` sets a board policy of a delivery board (KAIROS-T-0565).
With the policy on, a blocked task does not move into a claims column
or a done column. On a board of a different level, the
field is a 422 `VALIDATION`.

The short-code prefix of a board does not change (COLLIERY-T-3099). A
body with `code_prefix` is a 422 `CODE_PREFIX_IS_FIXED` that says so
(COLLIERY-T-3101), and the update writes nothing.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | yes | `string` | Board id (UUID) |

Request body (required): `application/json`, [`UpdateBoardRequest`](../schemas/#updateboardrequest)

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`Board`](../schemas/#board) | Updated |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Missing capability |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown board |
| `409` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | A live board has the slug; details.board names it |
| `422` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | No field to update, BOARD_TEAM_IS_FIXED, or CODE_PREFIX_IS_FIXED |

### `POST /api/boards/{id}/archive-completed`

Archive each live task in the done columns of a board (KAIROS-T-0363,
"Archive completed"). A cancelled task is in a done column, so it goes
too. A restore brings back each task, as for each archived item.

Each task goes through the one archive of the server
(`cascade::archive_item`). Each rule of an archive of one task
applies: the edit rule, the cascade, the claim and the history.

ONE TRANSACTION: the call archives each task, or it archives none. A
refusal of one task (a 403 of the edit rule) refuses the call.

Requires `manage_tasks` on the board (an organization admin has it):
the capability that archives each task of the board. The creator of a
task can archive that task one at a time. A board that is not a
delivery board holds no tasks: 422 `NOT_DELIVERY_BOARD`.

`?older_than_days=N` archives only the done tasks that entered their
done column at least N days ago (KAIROS-T-0649). The time of entry is
the last move of the task, or its creation. N is a whole number from 1
to 36500. Another value is a 422 `VALIDATION` with `details.field` =
`older_than_days`.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | yes | `string` | The slug or the id (UUID) of the board |
| `older_than_days` | query | no | `integer` | Archive only the done tasks that entered their done column at least this many days ago: a whole number from 1 to 36500. With no value, the call archives each done task. |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`ArchiveCompletedResponse`](../schemas/#archivecompletedresponse) | The archived tasks: the count and the codes. A count of 0 when the done columns are empty |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Missing manage_tasks on the board |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown board |
| `422` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | NOT_DELIVERY_BOARD, or VALIDATION for an `older_than_days` out of range |

### `PUT /api/boards/{id}/code-sequences/{item_type}`

Set the number of the next code of a type on a board (COLLIERY-T-3104).
An organization admin, or `manage_structure` on the organization
(KAIROS-T-0337).

The next create of `item_type` on the board gets the code
`{code_prefix}-{type letter}-{next_number}`. The Metis import uses this
route to keep the Metis numbers on a board (`--codes keep`).

A sequence never goes back. `next_number` must be above the last
number of the sequence of the prefix and the type. It must also be above
the number of each code of that prefix and type: live, archived or
retired. The next number of the sequence changes nothing. Thus you can
send the same request 2 times.

- A code that an item has (live or archived) is a 409 `CODE_IN_USE`.
- A retired code (COLLIERY-T-3100) is a 409 `CODE_RETIRED`, with
  `details.current_code` when the item exists.
- A different number at or below the sequence is a 409
  `SEQUENCE_IS_PAST`, with `details.next_code`.
- An `item_type` that the board does not hold is a 422 `VALIDATION` with
  `details.parameter` = `item_type` and `details.allowed`. A board holds
  the type of its level and documents.
- A `next_number` below 1 is a 422 `VALIDATION` with `details.field` =
  `next_number`. An unknown field is a 422 that names it.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | yes | `string` | The slug or the id (UUID) of the board |
| `item_type` | path | yes | `string` | `strategy|initiative|task|document|adr`: a type that the board holds |

Request body (required): `application/json`, [`SetCodeSequenceRequest`](../schemas/#setcodesequencerequest)

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`CodeSequence`](../schemas/#codesequence) | The sequence; next_code is the code of the next create |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Not an org admin, and no manage_structure on the organization |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown board |
| `409` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | CODE_IN_USE, CODE_RETIRED, or SEQUENCE_IS_PAST |
| `422` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | An item_type that the board does not hold, a next_number below 1, or an unknown field |

### `PATCH /api/boards/{id}/columns/{col_id}`

Rename and/or move a column (T-0010 rules; moving reorders the board's
columns around the new position). Requires `configure_boards`.

This route also sets the flags `is_done` and `claims` (KAIROS-T-0359).
A person who moves a task into a column with `claims` gets the claim of
the task. When the flag goes off, the claims of the tasks in the column
end.

It also sets the WIP limit of the column (`wip_limit`, KAIROS-T-0371): a
number above 0, or `null` to remove it. Kairos does not refuse a move into
a column over its limit. The answer of the move has a warning in the
header `Kairos-Warning`.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | yes | `string` | Board id (UUID) |
| `col_id` | path | yes | `string` | Column id (UUID) |

Request body (required): `application/json`, [`UpdateColumnRequest`](../schemas/#updatecolumnrequest)

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`BoardColumn`](../schemas/#boardcolumn) | Updated |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Missing capability |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown board/column |
| `422` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | DUPLICATE_COLUMN_NAME / VALIDATION |

### `GET /api/boards/{id}/items`

One page of the items on the board, grouped by column (columns in
position order; every entity type — strategies, initiatives, tasks,
ADRs). Open tenant-wide. `?repository=` narrows the tasks
(KAIROS-T-0104).

The route has pages (COLLIERY-T-0261). `limit` is 200 by default and
1000 at most. `total` is the number of items after the filters, on all
pages. Each column is in each page. `children_progress` and
`blocks_summary` have the items of the page.

The order of the items is: the position of the column, then the type,
then the short code. The order of the types is: strategy, initiative,
task, ADR.

`?include_deleted=true` adds the archived cards back, in the column
each was put away in and marked with `archived_at` (KAIROS-T-0159).
That is an audit view, not a board view — "what was in Done last
quarter?" rather than "what is on the board now?". The opt-in does not
change the counts. The blocks summary counts live rows only: ADR-20
rule 5 says archived work is not live work. The children-progress
rollup counts an archived child by the column that it was archived
from (KAIROS-T-0571): from a done column as done, from another column
in `removed`.

`blocks_summary` counts only the `blocks` edges that can still block
(COLLIERY-T-0214). Done work does not block, and nothing blocks done
work. An edge with either end in a terminal column (`is_done`) adds to
neither card. The edge stays on the relationship list of each item,
with a mark on the done end.

Each item is a card (KAIROS-T-0602). A card has no `content`,
`created_by` or `updated_by`. `?fields=full` adds them: then the
response has the shape that the route had before cards. The item route
of a card gives its content.

`?code=<short_code>` gives the card of one item (KAIROS-T-0615). The
page then has that card, or no card when no card of the board has the
code. The columns, their counts and the maps are as for a page. A live
board reads one card in this way after an event of that item.

Each card has `entered_column_at` and `notes_count` (KAIROS-T-0649).
`entered_column_at` is the time of the last move of the card, or the
time of its creation. `notes_count` is the number of its notes. The
page query reads the two for the cards of the page only.

`?done_limit=N` keeps the last N cards of each done column, by
`entered_column_at` (KAIROS-T-0649). The other columns keep each card.
`item_count` stays the count of the full column, and `total` counts
the cards after the limit. `?code=` applies after the limit. N must be
at least 1. Another value is a 422 `VALIDATION` with `details.field` =
`done_limit`.

The path takes the slug or the id of the board (COLLIERY-T-0265). An
unknown slug and an unknown id are a 404.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | yes | `string` | The slug or the id (UUID) of the board |
| `repository` | query | no | `string` | Narrow the TASKS to those bound to this repository (slug or UUID). Other entity types are unaffected. Unknown repository → 422. |
| `include_deleted` | query | no | `boolean` | Include archived (put-away) cards, each marked with `archived_at` (KAIROS-A-0020 rule 2). Default false — a board is a live board unless the reader says otherwise (rule 3). |
| `limit` | query | no | `integer` | The number of items on a page (default 200, maximum 1000). The server changes a larger value to 1000. |
| `offset` | query | no | `integer` | The number of items to skip (default 0). |
| `team` | query | no | `string` | Narrow the STRATEGIES and the INITIATIVES to those of this team (slug or UUID), from tasks or set by hand (KAIROS-T-0321). Tasks and ADRs are unaffected. Unknown team → 422. Not with `no_team`. |
| `no_team` | query | no | `boolean` | Narrow the STRATEGIES and the INITIATIVES to those with no team (KAIROS-T-0321). Tasks and ADRs are unaffected. Not with `team`. |
| `with_metadata` | query | no | `boolean` | Add `item_metadata` to the response: the metadata values of each item of the page (KAIROS-T-0368). Default false. |
| `fields` | query | no | `string` (`card`, `full`) | `card` (the default): the cards have no `content`, `created_by` or `updated_by`. `full`: the cards have them, as before cards (KAIROS-T-0602). An other value is refused. |
| `code` | query | no | `string` | Only the card with this short code (KAIROS-T-0615). The page then has one card, or no card when the board has no such card. A live board reads one card with it after an event of that item. |
| `done_limit` | query | no | `integer` | Only the last N cards of each done column, by the time that each card entered the column (KAIROS-T-0649). The other columns keep each card. `item_count` stays the count of the full column. At least 1. |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`BoardItemsResponse`](../schemas/#boarditemsresponse) | One page of the items, grouped by column |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown board |

### `GET /api/boards/{id}/webhook-deliveries`

The delivery log of a board, newest first: each delivery with its

| `id` | path | yes | `string` | The slug or the id (UUID) of the board |

| `limit` | query | no | `integer` | The newest deliveries to give, 1 to 200 (50). |
| `before` | query | no | `string` | The id of a delivery of the log: the page has the deliveries older than it (KAIROS-T-0584). |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | array of [`WebhookDelivery`](../schemas/#webhookdelivery) | The deliveries, newest first |

Make a webhook target on a board. Kairos makes the secret, and shows it

| `422` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | VALIDATION: a bad name, a URL that is not http(s), or a private address |

Remove a webhook target of a board, with its dispatch rules and its
delivery log. Needs `configure_boards` on the board.

|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | yes | `string` | The slug or the id (UUID) of the board |
| `target_id` | path | yes | `string` | The id (UUID) of the target |

| Response | Body | Meaning |

### `POST /api/boards/{id}/webhook-targets/{target_id}/enable`

Turn a webhook target on again, with its failed tries in a row at 0.
Kairos queues the `skipped` deliveries of the last 30 days again, oldest
first (KAIROS-T-0577); `redelivered` counts them. Needs
`configure_boards` on the board.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | yes | `string` | The slug or the id (UUID) of the board |
| `target_id` | path | yes | `string` | The id (UUID) of the target |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`WebhookTarget`](../schemas/#webhooktarget) | The target, on, with the count of the skipped deliveries queued again |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Missing configure_boards |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown board or target |

### `POST /api/boards/{id}/webhook-targets/{target_id}/redeliver`

Queue the `skipped` deliveries of a webhook target again
(KAIROS-T-0577). Kairos takes each one of the last 30 days, oldest
first. With `since`, it takes only the events at or after that time.
Each delivery keeps its id. The target must be on. Needs
`configure_boards` on the board, as `enable`.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | yes | `string` | The slug or the id (UUID) of the board |
| `target_id` | path | yes | `string` | The id (UUID) of the target |
| `since` | query | no | `string` | Only the deliveries of events at or after this time (RFC 3339). With no value: each skipped delivery of the last 30 days. |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`WebhookTarget`](../schemas/#webhooktarget) | The target, with the count of the skipped deliveries queued again |
| `400` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | VALIDATION: an unknown query parameter |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Missing configure_boards |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown board or target |
| `409` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | CONFLICT: the target is off; turn it on with enable |
| `422` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | VALIDATION: since is not an RFC 3339 timestamp |

### `POST /api/boards/{id}/webhook-targets/{target_id}/test`

Send a test delivery (the event `ping`) to a webhook target. Needs
`configure_boards` on the board.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | yes | `string` | The slug or the id (UUID) of the board |
| `target_id` | path | yes | `string` | The id (UUID) of the target |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `201` | [`WebhookDelivery`](../schemas/#webhookdelivery) | The delivery, queued (or skipped when the target is off) |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Missing configure_boards |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown board or target |

Remove a member: revoke ALL their capabilities on the board (T-0011

| `id` | path | yes | `string` | Board id (UUID) |
| `user_id` | path | yes | `string` | User id (UUID) |

| Response | Body | Meaning |

| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Missing administer_members |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown board, or user is not a member |

### `PATCH /api/boards/{id}/members/{user_id}`

Replace a member's capability set (revokes what is absent, grants what
is new — each change is a T-0011 grant/revoke with its activity row).
Requires `administer_members` on the board (or org admin).

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | yes | `string` | Board id (UUID) |
| `user_id` | path | yes | `string` | User id (UUID) |

Request body (required): `application/json`, [`ReplaceCapabilitiesRequest`](../schemas/#replacecapabilitiesrequest)

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`BoardMember`](../schemas/#boardmember) | The member's new capability set |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Missing administer_members |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown board, or user is not a member |
| `422` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Capability outside the A-0006 vocabulary |

### `GET /api/members/{user_id}/grants`

The grants of one person on the boards that the caller administers
(KAIROS-T-0413). The answer also gives the teams of the person.

An organization admin sees each live board. A holder of
`administer_members` sees only the boards where it holds it. `teams` is
`null` unless the caller can change team members.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `user_id` | path | yes | `string` | User id (UUID) |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`UserGrants`](../schemas/#usergrants) | The grants of the person on each board that the caller administers |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | The caller administers no board |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | The user is not a member of the organization |

### `PATCH /api/members/{user_id}/grants`

Change the grants of one person on one or more boards, in ONE
transaction (KAIROS-T-0413).

Each entry of `changes` names a board. It gives the capabilities to
grant and the stored grants to revoke.

The caller must administer each board. A board that the caller cannot
administer refuses all of the change (403). The refusal names the board.
A grant must apply at the level of the board (422).

A grant that the person has already refuses all of the change (409).
A revoke of a grant that the person does not have refuses it too (404).
Each grant and each revoke writes its activity row. The answer is the
new view, as `GET` gives it.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `user_id` | path | yes | `string` | User id (UUID) |

Request body (required): `application/json`, [`ChangeUserGrantsRequest`](../schemas/#changeusergrantsrequest)

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`UserGrants`](../schemas/#usergrants) | All the changes were applied; the new grants |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | The caller cannot administer a board of the change; no change was applied |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown board or user, or a revoke of a grant that the person does not have |
| `409` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | A grant that the person has already |
| `422` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | No change, a board two times, or a capability that does not apply at the level of the board |

## teams

### `GET /api/teams`

List teams (open tenant-wide).

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `limit` | query | no | `integer` | Page size (default 50, max 200). |
| `offset` | query | no | `integer` | Rows to skip (default 0). |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`ListEnvelope_Team`](../schemas/#listenvelope_team) | Page of teams |
| `401` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Missing/invalid token |

### `POST /api/teams`

Create a team AND its delivery board (seeded from the system delivery
defaults, slug `{slug}-delivery`) in one transaction. An organization admin,
or `manage_structure` on the organization (KAIROS-T-0337).

The slug must match `^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{1,62}$`, and it cannot have the
form of a UUID (COLLIERY-T-0260). If not, the request is a 422
`VALIDATION` with `details.field` = `slug`.

A live board can have the slug `{slug}-delivery` already
(COLLIERY-T-0255). Then the request is a 409 `CONFLICT` that names that
board, and the server creates no team.

`code_prefix` is the short-code prefix of the delivery board
(COLLIERY-T-3099). It is required. A prefix that does not match
`^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]{1,9}$` is a 422 `VALIDATION` with `details.field` =
`code_prefix`. A prefix that a live delivery board has is a 409
`CONFLICT` that names that board. In each case the server creates no
team.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Idempotency-Key` | header | no | `string`, nullable | Optional. A key that you choose for this write: 8 to 128 characters of letters, digits, '.', '_', ':' and '-' (a UUID is a good key). Send it when you may retry the request. For 24 hours, a request with the same key and the same arguments writes nothing and gives the first status and body again, with the header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`. The same key with other arguments is refused with REQUEST_KEY_REUSED (KAIROS-A-0065). |

Request body (required): `application/json`, [`CreateTeamRequest`](../schemas/#createteamrequest)

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `201` | [`Team`](../schemas/#team) | Created; delivery_board_id names the team's new board |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Not an org admin, and no manage_structure on the organization |
| `409` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | A live team has the slug, a live board has the slug of the delivery board, or a live delivery board has the prefix; or REQUEST_KEY_REUSED: the Idempotency-Key was used for a different request |
| `422` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Bad team_type, the slug does not have the form of a slug, or the code_prefix is absent or does not match the rule |

### `GET /api/teams/by-slug/{slug}`

One live team by SLUG (open tenant-wide; KAIROS-T-0083 — the web
client resolves `/teams/:slug` here instead of scanning the list).

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `slug` | path | yes | `string` | Team slug |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`Team`](../schemas/#team) | The team |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown slug |

### `GET /api/teams/{id}`

Get one team (open tenant-wide).

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | yes | `string` | The slug or the id (UUID) of the team |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`Team`](../schemas/#team) | The team |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown team |

### `DELETE /api/teams/{id}`

Soft-delete a team and its delivery board together. The board must be
empty (422 `BOARD_NOT_EMPTY` — the T-0010 empty rule). An organization
admin, or `manage_structure` on the organization (KAIROS-T-0337).

A team of old data can have 2 or more live delivery boards. The delete
applies the rule to each board, and it removes each board with the team
(COLLIERY-T-0250). The refusal names the board that is not empty.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | yes | `string` | The slug or the id (UUID) of the team |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`OrgDeleteResponse`](../schemas/#orgdeleteresponse) | Team and delivery board soft-deleted |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Not an org admin, and no manage_structure on the organization |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown team |
| `422` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | BOARD_NOT_EMPTY, or BOARD_OWNS_DOCUMENTS |

### `PATCH /api/teams/{id}`

Update a team (name/slug/team_type). An organization admin, or
`manage_structure` on the organization (KAIROS-T-0337). The delivery
board's name/slug are independent and unchanged.

A new slug must match `^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{1,62}$`, and it cannot have the
form of a UUID (COLLIERY-T-0260). If not, the request is a 422
`VALIDATION` with `details.field` = `slug`. A team with a slug from
before the rule keeps that slug.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | yes | `string` | The slug or the id (UUID) of the team |

Request body (required): `application/json`, [`UpdateTeamRequest`](../schemas/#updateteamrequest)

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`Team`](../schemas/#team) | Updated |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Not an org admin, and no manage_structure on the organization |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown team |
| `409` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Slug already in use |
| `422` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Bad team_type, empty body, or the new slug does not have the form of a slug |

The dictionary of the team (KAIROS-T-0734, KAIROS-T-0733). It gives the

| Response | Body | Meaning |

| `409` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | The team has more than one delivery board |

### `GET /api/teams/{id}/links`

The team's in-flight forge links (KAIROS-T-0101): links whose item is
a task of this team, or an item on the team's delivery board, or whose
repository is attributed to the team. Open tenant-wide.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | yes | `string` | The slug or the id (UUID) of the team |
| `state` | query | no | `string` | Comma-separated states; defaults to `open,draft` — the panel's question is "what is in flight", not merged history. |
| `limit` | query | no | `integer` | Result cap (default 100). |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | array of [`TeamLink`](../schemas/#teamlink) | In-flight links, newest first |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown team |

### `GET /api/teams/{id}/members`

List a team's members (open tenant-wide).

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | yes | `string` | The slug or the id (UUID) of the team |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | array of [`TeamMember`](../schemas/#teammember) | Members |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown team |

### `POST /api/teams/{id}/members`

Add a member to a team. An organization admin, or `manage_structure`
on the organization (KAIROS-T-0337).

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | yes | `string` | The slug or the id (UUID) of the team |

Request body (required): `application/json`, [`AddTeamMemberRequest`](../schemas/#addteammemberrequest)

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `201` | [`TeamMember`](../schemas/#teammember) | Added |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Not an org admin, and no manage_structure on the organization |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown team |
| `409` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Already a member |
| `422` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown user |

### `DELETE /api/teams/{id}/members/{user_id}`

Remove a member from a team. An organization admin, or
`manage_structure` on the organization (KAIROS-T-0337).

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | yes | `string` | The slug or the id (UUID) of the team |
| `user_id` | path | yes | `string` | User id (UUID) |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`OrgDeleteResponse`](../schemas/#orgdeleteresponse) | Removed |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Not an org admin, and no manage_structure on the organization |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown team or not a member |

### `GET /api/teams/{id}/standup`

The team of a stand-up and its people.

The people are the members of the team, by display name. Some people
are not members but claim a task of the team or own an initiative of
the team. They get a turn too, with `member: false`. A service account
is not in the list. The page shuffles the list.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | yes | `string` | The slug or the id (UUID) of the team |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`Standup`](../schemas/#standup) | The team and its people |
| `401` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Missing/invalid token |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown team |

### `GET /api/teams/{id}/standup/people/{user_id}`

The work of one person in a team, in two lanes.

- Initiatives: the initiatives that the person owns and that have the
  team (from their tasks, or set by hand).
- Tasks: the tasks on the boards of the team that the person, or an
  agent key of the person, claims.

Any member of the organization can read the work of any person. The
person does not have to be a member of the team.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | yes | `string` | The slug or the id (UUID) of the team |
| `user_id` | path | yes | `string` | The id (UUID) of the person |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`MyWork`](../schemas/#mywork) | The two lanes of the work of the person in the team |
| `401` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Missing/invalid token |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown team or person |

### `GET /api/teams/{id}/standup/unclaimed`

The last stop of a stand-up. It gives the tasks on the boards of the
team that no one claims, in the state Todo or Blocked. A task in Backlog
is not in it.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | yes | `string` | The slug or the id (UUID) of the team |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`UnclaimedWork`](../schemas/#unclaimedwork) | The unclaimed tasks of the team |
| `401` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Missing/invalid token |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown team |

### `GET /api/teams/{id}/unlinked-refs`

The in-flight branches and pull requests with no linked item, in the
repositories of the team (KAIROS-T-0480). This is the other half of the
rollup of `/api/teams/{id}/links`. Open tenant-wide.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | yes | `string` | The slug or the id (UUID) of the team |
| `state` | query | no | `string` | Comma-separated states; defaults to `open,draft` — the panel's question is "what is in flight", not merged history. |
| `limit` | query | no | `integer` | Result cap (default 100). |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | array of [`ForgeRef`](../schemas/#forgeref) | Branches and pull requests with no linked item, newest first |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown team |

### `GET /api/teams/{id}/work-documents`

The documents of the team (KAIROS-T-0084, KAIROS-T-0393). A board of
the team owns each live document, or the document supports a task of
the team or an item on its delivery board. Each row gives the reason.
Open tenant-wide.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | yes | `string` | The slug or the id (UUID) of the team |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | array of [`TeamWorkDocument`](../schemas/#teamworkdocument) | The documents of the team, by short code |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown team |

### `POST /api/teams/{id}/pages`

Create a page or folder (team member or org admin).

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | yes | `string` | The slug or the id (UUID) of the team |
| `Idempotency-Key` | header | no | `string`, nullable | Optional. A key that you choose for this write: 8 to 128 characters of letters, digits, '.', '_', ':' and '-' (a UUID is a good key). Send it when you may retry the request. For 24 hours, a request with the same key and the same arguments writes nothing and gives the first status and body again, with the header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`. The same key with other arguments is refused with REQUEST_KEY_REUSED (KAIROS-A-0065). |

Request body (required): `application/json`, [`CreateTeamPageRequest`](../schemas/#createteampagerequest)

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `201` | [`TeamPage`](../schemas/#teampage) | Created |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Not a team member |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown team |
| `409` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | REQUEST_KEY_REUSED: the Idempotency-Key was used for a different request |
| `422` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Bad kind/parent, sibling slug conflict, or content too large |

## delivery-streams

### `GET /api/delivery-streams`

List delivery streams (open tenant-wide).

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `limit` | query | no | `integer` | Page size (default 50, max 200). |
| `offset` | query | no | `integer` | Rows to skip (default 0). |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`ListEnvelope_DeliveryStream`](../schemas/#listenvelope_deliverystream) | Page of streams |
| `401` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Missing/invalid token |

### `POST /api/delivery-streams`

Create a delivery stream. Org-admin-only.

The slug must match `^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{1,62}$`, and it cannot have the
form of a UUID (COLLIERY-T-0260). If not, the request is a 422
`VALIDATION` with `details.field` = `slug`.

Request body (required): `application/json`, [`CreateStreamRequest`](../schemas/#createstreamrequest)

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `201` | [`DeliveryStream`](../schemas/#deliverystream) | Created |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Not an org admin |
| `409` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Slug already in use |
| `422` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | The slug does not have the form of a slug |

### `GET /api/delivery-streams/{id}`

Get one delivery stream (open tenant-wide).

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | yes | `string` | Stream id (UUID) |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`DeliveryStream`](../schemas/#deliverystream) | The stream |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown stream |

### `DELETE /api/delivery-streams/{id}`

Soft-delete a delivery stream (team links are left in place — the
stream is recoverable). Org-admin-only.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | yes | `string` | Stream id (UUID) |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`OrgDeleteResponse`](../schemas/#orgdeleteresponse) | Soft-deleted |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Not an org admin |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown stream |

### `PATCH /api/delivery-streams/{id}`

Update a delivery stream. Org-admin-only.

A new slug must match `^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{1,62}$`, and it cannot have the
form of a UUID (COLLIERY-T-0260). If not, the request is a 422
`VALIDATION` with `details.field` = `slug`. A delivery stream with a
slug from before the rule keeps that slug.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | yes | `string` | Stream id (UUID) |

Request body (required): `application/json`, [`UpdateStreamRequest`](../schemas/#updatestreamrequest)

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`DeliveryStream`](../schemas/#deliverystream) | Updated |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Not an org admin |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown stream |
| `409` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Slug already in use |
| `422` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Empty body, or the new slug does not have the form of a slug |

### `GET /api/delivery-streams/{id}/teams`

Teams in this stream (open tenant-wide).

|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | yes | `string` | Stream id (UUID) |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | array of [`Team`](../schemas/#team) | Teams in the stream |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown stream |

### `POST /api/delivery-streams/{id}/teams`

Add a team to a stream. Org-admin-only.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | yes | `string` | Stream id (UUID) |

Request body (required): `application/json`, [`AddStreamTeamRequest`](../schemas/#addstreamteamrequest)

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|

| `422` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown team |

### `DELETE /api/delivery-streams/{id}/teams/{team_id}`

Remove a team from a stream. Org-admin-only.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | yes | `string` | Stream id (UUID) |
| `team_id` | path | yes | `string` | Team id (UUID) |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`OrgDeleteResponse`](../schemas/#orgdeleteresponse) | Removed |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Not an org admin |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown stream or team not in stream |

## members

### `GET /api/members`

List the organization's members (open tenant-wide, paginated, ordered
by email).

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `limit` | query | no | `integer` | Page size (default 50, max 200). |
| `offset` | query | no | `integer` | Rows to skip (default 0). |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`ListEnvelope_OrgMember`](../schemas/#listenvelope_orgmember) | Page of members |
| `401` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Missing/invalid token |

### `POST /api/members`

Add a member by email. The user must have logged in once already (JIT
provisioning creates `public.users` rows at first login) — unknown
email is 404 with that guidance. Org-admin-only.

Request body (required): `application/json`, [`AddOrgMemberRequest`](../schemas/#addorgmemberrequest)

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `201` | [`OrgMember`](../schemas/#orgmember) | Added |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Not an org admin |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | No user with this email has logged in yet |
| `409` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Already a member |
| `422` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Bad role |

### `DELETE /api/members/{user_id}`

Remove a member. Removing the LAST admin is rejected (422 `LAST_ADMIN`).
Kairos revokes the agent keys of the member in the same transaction
(KAIROS-T-0388). Then the strategies and the initiatives of the member
have no owner (KAIROS-T-0411). The tasks that the member has the claim
on are free (KAIROS-T-0531). Org-admin-only.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `user_id` | path | yes | `string` | The member: a user id (UUID), an email or a user name |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`RemoveOrgMemberResponse`](../schemas/#removeorgmemberresponse) | Removed |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Not an org admin |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Not a member |
| `422` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | LAST_ADMIN |

### `PATCH /api/members/{user_id}`

Change a member's role. Demoting the LAST admin is rejected (422
`LAST_ADMIN`). Org-admin-only.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `user_id` | path | yes | `string` | The member: a user id (UUID), an email or a user name |

Request body (required): `application/json`, [`UpdateOrgMemberRequest`](../schemas/#updateorgmemberrequest)

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`OrgMember`](../schemas/#orgmember) | Updated |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Not an org admin |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Not a member |
| `422` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | LAST_ADMIN or bad role |
